scope: Summary of a recorded run; not a new verification. Full report is local and ignored by Git.

decisions.H01: accept separate warm/cold/fixed-duration methodology; moving states are not assumed equal
decisions.H02: reject tested transparency-only counter removal: negligible benefit; exact written count preserved
decisions.H03: reject tested exact paired edge UV setup; shared world UV not implemented
decisions.H04: defer broader black-distance renderer: little far ceiling/masked work in six views; opaque/intersecting faces not exhausted
decisions.H05: performance verified; gameplay impact of minor quality reduction remains to be assessed in G25; pixel differences alone do not reject it
decisions.H06: reject tested enlarged zero-word shortcut against its matched control; other sparse kernels not disproved
decisions.H07: accept split legacy path plus hot active edges after full emulator regression
decisions.H08: defer raster cache pending bounded memory/composition design; only 668 B EWRAM free
decisions.H09: continue in G25: allow minor degradation without material gameplay impact; exact pixel equality is not the acceptance gate
decisions.H10: conditional defer: no new transport model; old feedback not rerun
decisions.H11: conditional defer: no new proven offline packing/admission; old GPU fallback not rerun

limitations: No physical GBA or original BIOS acceptance; BUG02 remains open/deferred.
Fixed 600 video frames and timestamped inputs do not guarantee identical live world states or published tick counts.
Cold experiment invalidates geometry only; assets/PCM stay warm, presentation FPS intentionally unavailable.
Old battle presentation-count fixture is a load test, not equal-state causal timing.
No claim of global speed optimum or completion of all possible H02/H03/H04/H06/H08/H09 implementations.
96-row quality not accepted. No separate Performance product or public release.
